description.text: sits low in frame inside a tunnel, its body catching only a thin rim of light from the headlights. The beams cut two long cones through the gloom, revealing rough concrete walls, damp streaks, and grit on the tarmac. The car is still at first, then its nose lifts slightly as the engine takes load. The darkness around the body remains heavy, so the headlights and the first answering reflection on the wall become the brightest shapes. A faint echo returns from the tunnel curve, and the low idle deepens. The car begins to ease forward, the front wheels rolling a few centimetres over the gritted surface. The movement pulls the beams across the wall and lets the tunnel recede into depth behind the body.
A low engine idle and a faint tunnel echo settle in the dark.
eases forward, its headlights sweeping the wall and pulling texture from the gloom.
The engine note deepens as the car begins to take load.

continues forward in a sustained roll, gathering speed as the twin headlight beams sweep the curved wall and pull texture out of the dark. The car's shape tracks through frame from left toward right while the tunnel opens around it: ribbed panels, low cable trays, and a damp shine on the road surface become readable in the moving light. Tyres hiss over grit, and the engine note rises steadily under the load. The body stays low and steady as the beams reach farther ahead, revealing the bend and the first grey light beyond. The car's forward motion carries it deeper into the lit corridor, and the contrast between the black rear of the tunnel and the brightening road ahead grows sharper.
The engine note rises steadily and tyres roll over gritted tarmac.
gathers speed, its beams sweeping the curved wall as the tunnel becomes readable.
A sustained engine load carries through the tunnel with a faint echo.

surges clear of the deepest shadow as the road ahead brightens. Its body catches a broader wash of light, showing the roof line, the dark windows, and the dust along the lower panels. The headlight beams shorten against the growing daylight, and the tunnel walls fall behind into a softer grey. The car pushes forward with sustained momentum, the engine held under load, while air rushes past the bodywork and grit ticks beneath the tyres. The last of the darkness slides off the rear of the car, leaving the vehicle fully lit as it pulls ahead. The motion resolves in a clean forward glide, with the tunnel opening wide around it and the road surface shining ahead.
The engine stays under load and air rushes past the bodywork.
pulls fully into the light, its shape brightening as the dark falls behind it.
Tyres tick over grit as the engine note sustains through the open tunnel mouth.

soundscape: Low engine idle deepening under load, tyres rolling over gritted tarmac, and a faint tunnel echo.
